name: Controller unreachable
note: The laptop is offline from the cloud controller, but its own agents keep running and stay usable.

steps.label: connect: unreachable
steps.say: No network, or the controller is down. Today's desktop app would show nothing useful.

steps.label: attach via K2_HOST_LOCAL_ATTACH
steps.say: The app falls back to the laptop's own host on a loopback port, authenticated with a token only this machine holds.

steps.label: local agents + scrollback
steps.say: The host lists the agents it runs and replays their output from the PTY rings.

steps.label: keystrokes
steps.say: Typing goes straight to the agent's terminal. The agent never noticed the controller was gone.

steps.label: write to PTY
steps.say: Same terminal, same process as before.

steps.label: k2 msg cloud-agent (queued)
steps.say: Anything that needs the controller is accepted and shown as pending: new agents, messages to other machines, heartbeats.

steps.label: reconnect, flush queue
steps.say: When the link returns, the host replays queued events and the app switches back to the controller.
